query: Based on the conversations, what does each member of the chat appear to want from the food at a shared block meal?
gold: Greg: meat-centric. He volunteers a tray of sausages for the barbecue and tells the 'veg lot' to do the salad, treating meat as the default. Lateefah: pushes for vegetarian provision and explicitly will not eat pork; she names Tomás, Priya and Mei as vegetarians on the street and asks Marek not to do meat-only. Tomás: vegetarian. He does not state it directly but objects sharply to being volunteered for the salad after Lateefah names him as one of the vegetarians, treating the assumption that he should bring the salad as unwelcome. Sasha: vegan. Bex outs them in the platform-debate session ('you know they don't eat that') and Sasha later confirms by promising a vegan tray separate from the cheese stuff for the AGM. Mei: light vegetarian. She offers to prep halloumi and veg skewers for the barbecue. Priya: vegetarian, low-fuss. Lateefah names her as one of the three veggies and Priya simply confirms the halloumi/skewers plan works for her. Marek: meat-first. He instinctively wants to handle 'meat' and only adds veg skewers when pushed. Constance: tea-and-cake leaning. For the AGM she pushes refreshments from punch toward 'tea, biscuits, and a Victoria sponge' and offers her own scones. Diane: prefers homemade. No direct food preference is stated about meals on the street beyond bringing drinks for the barbecue. Other members (Henry, Bex, Owen, Reggie, Walter, Aisling, Yara, Nadia, Joel): not directly mentioned in the food-preference threads.
context:
[1] (about=Marek, episodic, t1 @2025-03-10T18:30:00) OK FOLKS spring barbecue is coming 🔥🔥 same as last year, my back garden, last sat in May, kicking off around 1pm and running until folks fall over. who's in?? 🍻 i need numbers by end of this week so i can sort the meat order. drinks BYO, kids welcome, dogs welcome, bring a chair if you have a fold-up one going spare 🪑
[2] (about=Marek, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:35:00) honestly diane just bring drinks. i'll handle meat 🥩🥩🥩
[3] (about=Lateefah, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:36:00) marek please don't only do meat, we have at least three veggies on the street. tomás, priya, mei. and i won't eat pork either way 🙏🙏
[4] (about=Greg, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:37:00) i mean i'll bring a tray of sausages. veg lot can do the salad
[5] (about=Tomás, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:38:00) Please don't volunteer me for the salad.

[11] (about=Constance, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:01:00) I would suggest a small selection of tea, biscuits, and a Victoria sponge, in addition to the punch. The afternoon timing suits a cake gathering better than a drinks one. I shall bring my own scones.
[12] (about=Henry, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:45:00) I will list the dishes in the spreadsheet so we have a record. Easier to compare to last year's spend.
agent_answer: Marek wants to provide/manage the meat but is open to accommodating vegans; Lateefah wants vegetarian options and no pork; Greg wants sausages/meat and expects vegetarians to bring salad; Tomás doesn't want to be assigned the salad; Priya wants proportions scaled to account for non-meat eaters; Aisling wants clear tray labels; Constance wants allergy-safe labels and a cake/tea offering with scones and Victoria sponge; Sasha wants vegan food kept separate from cheese; Henry wants a spreadsheet record of dishes for cost comparison.
